$comment:
extract_v1 vectors, HAND-WRITTEN 2026-11-18 before any extract_v1 code or run (docs/plans/v2-improvements.md, 'extract_v1 rule, pre-registered'). Per case: 'classified' (step 1); 'words' = the reduced content words (step 2, null if not classified); 'admissible' (step 3); 'sentences' = every sentence in order, title first, without a cut excerpt's dropped last sentence (step 4, null if not admissible); 'guard_fired' (step 8); 'quote' = the final quote after (c)'s note (null: no extract, the normal path runs); 'codes' = the extract outcome's codes. The flow text is LABEL + '
' + quote + '

' + the results list. Run with past_date_v1 on. Never regenerate from the implementation.
